MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE (CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) < 1 OR p.birth_date = '1995/10/2')
  AND (r.tenure = 'latest' OR (r.tenure = 'earlier' AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[rl:PlaysFor]->(:Team) WHERE rl.tenure = 'latest' }))
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, p.mvp_awards AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) < 1 OR p.birth_date = '1995/10/2'
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[rl:PlaysFor]->(tl:Team)
WHERE rl.tenure = 'latest'
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[re:PlaysFor]->(te:Team)
WHERE re.tenure = 'earlier'
WITH p, CASE WHEN tl IS NOT NULL THEN tl ELSE te END AS team
RETURN team.team_name AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, p.mvp_awards AS col3, p.name AS name_player
